title: Label wrap: width scales against Mermaid's own font size; class notes and members stay on one row

v:
Further amends decisions `01M4R4WDZ` and `01M4R7HBG`, after measuring class and ER diagrams in mermaid
11.17.2 (headless Chrome). Where they disagree, this one governs.

1. **Wrap width formula.** `wrap width = 200 × (size Siren draws the label at) / (size Mermaid draws it at)`.
   Mermaid draws most labels at 16px, so flowchart nodes, state text and notes stay 175 and flowchart edge,
   state transition and class relationship labels stay 150. Mermaid draws an **ER relationship label at
   14px** (21px line) and wraps it at 200, so Siren's 12px ER relationship label wraps at 200 × 12/14 ≈ 171.43.
   Each Siren row then holds as much text as a Mermaid row. `wrapWidthAt(px, mermaidPx = 16)` computes it;
   `wrapErRelationshipLabel` pairs that width with the 12px measurer and 18px rows.
2. **Class notes do not wrap.** Mermaid's class note `<div>` carries `max-width: 200px` but `display: table`
   ignores it, so the note is drawn on one row (measured 544px). Class members and ER attribute comments are
   drawn `nowrap` too. None of them wrap in Siren.
3. Scope, as built: flowchart nodes and edge labels; state names, descriptions, notes and transition labels;
   class and ER relationship labels. Never wrapped: subgraph and composite titles (a composite's own
   description is its title), class names, members and notes, ER entity names and attribute comments,
   anything in a sequence diagram.
